Third-party runtime notices

The provided Windows x64 executable is cross-compiled with the unmodified
official Debian trixie MinGW-w64 POSIX toolchain:

  GCC 14.2.0 (Debian package 14.2.0-19+27+b1)
  mingw-w64 headers and CRT 12.0.0-5
  binutils-mingw-w64-x86-64 2.44-3+12+b1

Static C++/GCC/winpthreads runtime linking is used. The adjacent notices are
copied unchanged from the corresponding official Debian binary packages.
GCC-runtime-notices.txt includes the GCC Runtime Library Exception;
MinGW-w64-notices.txt includes the CRT and winpthreads notices.

Upstream sources:
https://gcc.gnu.org/
https://www.mingw-w64.org/
https://deb.debian.org/debian/

No Wine or compiler binaries are distributed as part of this application.
